The '''Nwarcol system''' was in the [[Periphery/Legends|Periphery]]. It was the site of [[Nwarcol Point]], a key [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] where the [[Sisar Run/Legends|Sisar Run]] and [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]] merged.
